nodes.asset_description: Cluster of glossy 3D abstract shapes centered near the top: three pill/pebble-like forms in cyan-to-teal gradients and one six-lobed asterisk/flower shape. Colors range from light aqua (#AEEBEE) and icy cyan (#B9F2FF) to magenta-violet (#A33BFF) with soft studio lighting and subtle cast shadows. The forms are arranged in a gentle diagonal arc from left to right.

The word "Design" set in bold rounded sans-serif, filled with a left-to-right gradient transitioning from soft lavender (#C7A9FF) through light purple (#B68CFF) to vivid violet (#7D3CFF). Slight soft drop shadow; baseline aligned to the ampersand on the left.

Pill-shaped CTA button centered near the bottom. Background has a horizontal gradient from deep violet (#3A0B8C) at left through near-black (#0B0B12) to bright purple (#7C3CF2) at right, with a subtle inner glow. White uppercase label "READ MORE" centered-left in Helvetica Neue Medium. On the right end, a small circular purple capsule with a white downward chevron/arrow icon.
